status: Slew limiting does not eliminate READY2-associated RX-only faults or the observed SCL disturbance

fixture.target: Pi1 configure-once RX-only module, CR=0x205; IRQ + 300 us drain timer; no TX, response publication, READY operation or normal reconfiguration
fixture.controller: same seed-91 raw vectors, adapter retries 0; stop at first failure; 1000 us plus 23 us per byte inter-write delay
fixture.READY2: Pi2 GPIO17 push-pull pinctrl high/low loop; wiring unchanged, controller GPIO22/pin15
fixture.other_activity: Both production target services stopped throughout comparison; Pi2 BSC quiesced; other GPIO modes retained
fixture.scope: C1 SCL, C2 SDA, C3 READY2, C4 open-drain controller error marker via existing READY1 lead; 2 ns native samples
fixture.pad_control: Pi2 Pi3B+ GPIO0-27 bank, 0x3f10002c; original 0x1b -> limited 0x0b -> original 0x1b; only bit 4 changed; 8 mA drive and input hysteresis preserved
fixture.restore_guard: Independent 20 minute systemd restore timer installed before changing pads; cancelled only after original readback

phases.name: limited
phases.error: Lost arbitration (kernel confirmed); SDA low, SCL high

interpretation.established: All three pulse runs fail; slew limiting does not resolve the fault. Each retained failure tail contains a READY2 rising edge during an SCL rise, with a non-monotonic excursion on SCL. Both READY2 polarities must be considered.
interpretation.edge_effect: READY2 rise in the selected failure records is approximately 6/8/6 ns (original/limited/restored); typical sampled falls remain 6-8 ns. The selected SCL backsteps are approximately 0.37/0.22/0.29 V. Coupling remains visible with limiting enabled.
interpretation.limits: One stop-on-error long run per pad setting, not failure-rate statistics. Selected edges occur at different SCL phases; a smaller dip in one record does not establish an overall reduction. 2 ns sample granularity limits edge-time comparisons. Probe skew, input thresholds, local grounds and the physical coupling path remain uncalibrated. Bank-wide pad control and stopped Pi2 service differ from concurrent HSM traffic. No concurrent authenticated/PQC qualification is implied.
interpretation.next_physical_control: Measure at the receiving GPIO with a short local reference, then isolate signal/return-path coupling with controlled READY wiring or source damping. Do not infer a driver-only cause from a clean-looking wide-timebase trace.
